fixed_calculus: Rmix341 (unchanged); this experiment measures a different promised charge-bit query resource
established_hardness: Urquhart 1987 / Ben-Sasson Wigderson 2001: 2^{Omega(h)} ordinary shared-DAG Resolution lines on suitable odd expander Tseitin CNFs, NOT unrestricted SAT time
exact_theorem: For connected h-vertex graph G, promised charge-bit decision-tree complexity D_raw=h, D_recoded=1, under uniform invertible linear map y1=XOR_i chi_i; yi=chi_i for i>=2.
encoding: Fixed graph G and h charge bits as an explicit promise-input, with charged decoding into 4h-clause signed CNF. This is not a replacement general CNF encoding.
notes: The complete Python/JS harness and all charge data are in the local reproducibility archive. This GitHub JSON is a results ledger. No exact shortest-proof optimization is claimed for these finite tests.
limitations: A one-query already-reencoded charge promise does not bypass the 12h signed-occurrence original-bit observation floor. Conversion from original sources is charged. B1, B2, B3, worst-case mixed-calculus hardness, and P versus NP remain OPEN.
